sections.body: All around the world, families celebrate special days called festivals. 🎉
Diwali has little lamps 🪔. Eid often has new clothes and sharing sweets. Christmas has decorated trees 🎄. Lunar New Year has red lanterns 🏮.
Some festivals are religious and some are not. People celebrate in many different ways.
When a friend tells you about their festival, listen and say 'That sounds lovely!'
Share your own family's celebrations, and talk kindly about others'. This lesson is descriptive only and is shown only if you unlock it.

quiz.q: What do people light at Diwali?
hints: Diwali is a festival of light.
What gives light in a small clay pot?
At a birthday we light candles on a cake 🎂. At Diwali we light…?
quiz.explain: People light little lamps called diyas at Diwali! 🪔

quiz.q: Your friend tells you about their festival. What can you say?
hints: How would you like people to talk about your special days?
If a friend shows you their drawing, you might say 'I like it!'. Same with festivals.
quiz.explain: Kind words show respect: 'That sounds lovely!'
